status: resource-only audit; assessment subsequently checkpointed at user request; no automatic resumption

scope.note: The first 136 complete cases define this timing audit. Four later cases drained after the checkpoint request and belong to the separate operational checkpoint inventory; they are not mixed into this snapshot.

host.cpu_scope_note: Eight logical CPUs share four physical cores. An 8-vCPU linear-scaling estimate is deliberately optimistic; it does not establish the throughput of eight physical cores.

measured.excluded_cpu_scope: Controller and untimed dispatch/checkpoint overhead outside per-world/per-shadow intervals; CPU on any other process or remote host is not included. Assessment-worker CPU includes evaluator CPU and is added once.

scheduling.implementation: ProcessPoolExecutor(max_workers=4), exactly 4 cases per executor.map batch, barrier before next batch
scheduling.interpretation: This 21.3% is inferred from timed case durations and the observed scheduling rule, not a direct CPU-idle measurement or a guaranteed acceleration. Dynamic dispatch could recover part of the imbalance, not an order-of-magnitude speedup.

original_sample_size_plan.primary_comparisons: Selected online versus coherently frozen learning in stationary and switching regimes; Holm family of two tests. Planning uses alpha .025 per test.

sample_rule.planning_discordance: maximum one-sided 95% development upper bound across stationary/switch, or floor

original_sample_size_plan.limitation: Conditional planning power is not guaranteed: only 24 reused development cases per regime; the selected program was searched on them. Individual 95% discordance bounds are neither a simultaneous two-regime guarantee nor selection-adjusted intervals. Conservative planning bounds and the 1024-case floor reduce, but do not eliminate, this uncertainty. Final n is frozen regardless of assessment significance.
original_sample_size_plan.resource_note: Sample size was chosen from development precision, before final cases were drawn. It was not a 15–20 minute runtime budget. No cluster was provisioned.

remaining_at_136_case_snapshot.interpretation: Bounds on scenarios extrapolated from measured completed work, not confidence intervals, guaranteed lower bounds, or completion promises. They assume the unexecuted cases have comparable computational work and per-core execution cost. Eight SMT threads cannot be assumed to scale linearly. Provisioning, scheduling, IO, contention and clock behavior may worsen wall time.

clock_caveat.note: The stop-record clocks cover the whole launch, including shutdown, not precisely the 136-case prefix. UTC/GNU elapsed is about 10.2% longer than recorded wrapper monotonic elapsed; cause unresolved. Estimates above retain monotonic units. The UTC conversion is an illustrative sensitivity only; GNU totals are not added to per-episode CPU.

provenance.step_count_note: 226679 steps were summed from checkpoint steps fields during the original resource audit. No task, escape, prediction loss, or treatment-effect fields were inspected.
